observations: A full-size sewing machine on a wooden cabinet stand with foot pedal and metal base frame.
Machine body is light-colored with a dark control panel area and multiple knobs/dials.
There is visible wear/rust/paint scuffing on the machine casing (especially on the front/side surfaces).
The front of the machine has a brand plate/label area, but the exact brand/model text is not clearly readable in these photos.
The needle area and presser/bed area are visible, but there is no clear close-up of the needle, bobbin area, or stitch mechanism.
No power source, motor label, or working demonstration is shown in the photos.

claims.evidence: Photos show visible scuffs/rust/paint wear on the machine body; no proof of operation (stitching test) is provided.

risks.risk: Whether it is actually working (timing, needle/bobbin function, motor/power, and smooth feed). Photos cannot confirm operation.
risks.proof: A short video of the machine sewing a straight line on fabric (with the needle moving continuously) plus a close-up of the bobbin area while running.
risks.if_unproven: Price it as not proven working (worst case: needs service/repair).

risks.risk: Missing/incorrect parts (needle, bobbin case, presser foot, belt/motor components) or worn consumables.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of: needle + needle clamp, bobbin case/bobbin, presser foot, feed dogs, and the underside/belt area (if any).
risks.if_unproven: Price it as potentially incomplete/needs parts.

risks.risk: Electrical/motor condition (if it has a motor): weak motor, faulty switch, or wiring issues.
risks.proof: Photo of the motor label/spec plate (if present) and a video showing power-on and speed control working.
risks.if_unproven: Price it as motor/electrics not guaranteed.

risks.risk: Mechanical wear from age/use (timing belt/gears, feed mechanism, thread tension).
risks.proof: Video showing consistent stitch formation and tension adjustment results (before/after adjusting tension).
risks.if_unproven: Price it as worn and may require adjustment/servicing.

risks.risk: Rust/corrosion severity (visible scuffing suggests possible internal corrosion).
risks.proof: Close-up of the inside/under the bed area and any rusted metal surfaces; also show the underside of the machine head.
risks.if_unproven: Price it as having corrosion that may affect performance.

proof_requests: Send a video of it sewing (continuous stitching) on fabric, showing the needle, feed, and thread tension.
Send close-ups of the needle, bobbin case/bobbin, presser foot, and feed dogs.
Send a photo of any motor/engine label (or confirm if it’s manual) and the power/switch area.
Send a photo of the underside/belt/gears area (or where the drive comes from) to confirm completeness.
response.reason: The photos show a cabinet-mounted sewing machine with visible cosmetic wear, but there is no proof it works or what exact brand/model it is. Without a working test and clearer identity, a safe worst-case price can’t be set confidently.
